label: modern_population_sensitivity
label_text: Policy experiment on the modern population: not a replay or a costing of Autumn 2015.

diagnosis.summary: From policyengine-uk 2.134.1 (52030637b, fixing #2238) additional-dwelling and non-residential purchase prices are inputs, nil unless the dataset imputes them; before, every home buyer's whole stock of other residential property was charged as one additional-dwelling purchase. The interim Microcosm cut was built for 2.132.6 and does not supply the inputs, so on 2.143.0 no household buys an additional dwelling: modern-law SDLT falls from £15.0bn to £8.1bn in 2025-26 and the surcharge has nothing to act on. Microcosm imputes both from microcosm#1308 (the property_purchases stage), so the pre-Budget cut carries them. A model swap is valid only where the data carries the newer model's inputs.
